title: Lumière
keyLabel: D 大调／B 小调（2 个升号）
description: 《Lumière》，Lorien Testard 作曲，选自游戏《Clair Obscur: Expedition 33》原声带，本曲为长笛改编版。旋律温柔抒情，和声在明亮与幽暗间流转，长乐句气息绵长，适合练习歌唱性表达与力度的层次控制。
descriptionEn: "Lumière" by Lorien Testard, from the soundtrack of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, arranged here for flute. The melody is tender and lyrical, its harmonies drifting between light and shadow; the long phrases ask for generous breath — fine practice for singing tone and layered control of dynamics.
